title: HD Video Player All Formats
summary: Video Player All Format, 4K, MP4, MP3 Player, subtitle downloader, file manager
description:
Play all your videos in one powerful HD Video Player with 4K playback, subtitle support, floating player, gesture controls, playlists, and an organized media library.

Video player (MP3 player) for all formats like mp3, mp4, MOV, etc. It gives a list of features to play videos and songs.

This player supports all video formats like HD, Full HD, 4K, and Ultra HD video files. It is one of the best Powerful HD video player for Android.

 Enjoy this Christmas and New Year with smooth HD playback for all your favorite videos.

KEY FEATURES:
● Supports most popular formats like MKV, MP4, M4V, MOV, 3GP, FLV, WMV, TS, MP3, MPG, etc.
● Cast Video to TV from your Android phone.
● Built-in Video Downloader and mp3 player, mp4 player functionality
● Ultra HD video player supports FHD, 4K, and all types of video formats.
● Support multiple subtitle downloader, video downloader, and more.
● Play the video in a pop-up window, split-screen and Play-In background as an audio file.
● Hardware acceleration with the new HW+ decoder and Extension mode
● Keep selected video files safe in local storage with built-in video playback.
● Playback Speed and Dual Audio support in the MP3 player and mp4 player
● Sleep timer for Video and Music player.
● Built-in Gallery to Manage photo albums.
● Online trending videos play in mp3 player and mp4 player and more.
● Browse & Search all media files, create a playlist, search artists, albums, genre, etc.
● Manage Recently played videos and songs, resume, and start over option in the video player.
●Fast Video Downloader to quickly download and manage supported media files.
● Night Mode to protect eyes from blue light, Quick Mute option in Player screen.
● Identify all video files on your device and scan the SD Card automatically.
● Smart gestures to control volume, playing progress, and brightness.
● Smart playback options like Pinch to zoom, auto-rotation, aspect ratio, and screen lock.
● Multiple materials, gradient, and custom themes.
● Powerful Equalizer with Bass Boost and Virtualizer in mp3 player.
● Create Playlist and manage after downloading from the video downloader
● Manage selected files with File Manager and PIN access
● Filter duplicate

Video Player for All Formats
Play all video formats like MKV, MP4, M4V, MOV, 3GP, FLV, WMV, TS, MP3, MPG, etc.

Full HD Video Player
Play HD, Full HD, Ultra HD, 4k, 1080p, and all types of video files smoothly in Video Player, mp4 player and manage supported downloads through video downloader.

Play-in Background Video Player
Play videos in the background option in the video player. You can play the video in the background like music playback and you can watch a video in the way of multi-tasking.

Floating Video Player All Format
The floating Player helps you watch videos when you are doing another task. Enjoy video on the split-screen and use other apps as usual.

Filter for duplicate videos, photos, and media files.
Identify ALL video files on your device and SD Card automatically.

File Explorer, Files manager
Identify all video files and music files on your device and SD-Card automatically. In addition, manage downloaded videos or share supported files easily.
